title: RationalComparisonScalarSquare
statement: The two integral-to-field extension paths give a natural comparison phi for the actual rational transition functors, with components obtained from the integral phi, the two normalized scalar tower maps and the exact field scalar comparison. Exact field extension preserves the perfect image.

proof.text: The bundled integer-to-field composites agree. Naturality of normalized scalar tower maps on perfect objects gives the integral comparison. Whisker and compose it with the exact-field comparison. The latter transports scalar semilinearity from B, so tensor induction proves naturality on rational Hom modules. Perfectness is transported across the exact-field comparison.
